text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand received
a piece of fan mail.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
...W-Was it written all over my face!?
choice_data_list: What kind of letter was it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The letter handed to me by Cheval Grand was remarkably concise—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Cheval Grand-san,
I couldn't put it into words very well, but just one thing...
I'll keep cheering for you."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: The content of the letter is very simple.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still, this person... I get the feeling they're cheering me on
even more than their words let on.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...The envelope was repurposed from a nautical chart.
The sticker designed like an overseas postmark was totally to my liking, too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
And also... a hand-drawn illustration of an anchor.
I thought... maybe it's the emblem in the center of the marine cap I'm wearing.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy...
It warms me to the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Even if she's not good at expressing herself, she must be someone with deeply passionate feelings... I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to cheer you on, even if quietly"—somehow,
the sender felt a lot like Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Could we start training now?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I must keep running...
For their sake, as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cheval Grand seemed to gain immense courage from the fans' support.
